import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULUS = 1000000007;
    static int prime, power, result;
    static boolean[] visitedFlags;

    static int calculate() {
        result = 1;
        if (power == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < prime; ++i) {
                result = (int)((long)result * prime % MODULUS);
            }
        } else if (power == 1) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= prime; ++i) {
                result = (int)((long)result * prime % MODULUS);
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < prime; ++i) {
                if (!visitedFlags[i]) {
                    int cycleLength = 0;
                    int index = i;
                    while (!visitedFlags[index]) {
                        visitedFlags[index] = true;
                        ++cycleLength;
                        index = (int)((long)index * power % prime);
                    }
                    if (index != 0) {
                        result = (int)((long)result * prime % MODULUS);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        prime = scanner.nextInt();
        power = scanner.nextInt();
        visitedFlags = new boolean[prime];
        System.out.println(calculate());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
